text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ runs her best race ever...
but it still
isn't enough to win the spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If the venue for the race hadn't been
changed,
Biwa Hayahide could've
maximized the results of
her equation
and maybe even won...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ wants to be the greatest
of her
generation and eventually defeat
Нарита Брайан, so
she isn't satisfied with
her current performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's why our next goal is the
Takarazuka Kinen,
where only the best
are chosen to race. We begin
working
hard, so Бива Хаяхидэ can improve

even more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
